title: Harden rust/lichen-rpl time_option.rs API (P3 review findings)
description: Three P3 findings from wave-1 codereview of rust/lichen-rpl/src/time_option.rs: (1) from_option_data cannot verify the option type byte — any 6-byte payload with data[0] in 0..4 and data[1]==0 is silently accepted if a caller skips checking OptionIter raw.opt_type (Python's path revalidates the full 8 bytes incl. type; time_sync.py:755); consider a checked entry point or documented caller contract. (2) pub stratum/pub timestamp allow struct-literal construction violating the NoSync=>zero-timestamp invariant — all sinks re-validate so serialization is safe, but a consumer reading .timestamp directly can ingest an invariant-violating value; consider private fields + accessors. (3) from_bytes and from_option_data duplicate reserved/stratum/NoSync validation — from_bytes should delegate via &data[2..8] so invariants live in one place.
